shortDescription: Manage metro DR environment on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System

options.name: dr_array_id
options.description: Serial number of the DR array. It is required in create and convert operations.

options.name: env_name
options.description: Name of the metro DR environment. Metro DR environment name will be unique across PowerMax.

options.name: metro_r1_array_id
options.description: Serial number of the primary metro array.

options.name: metro_r2_array_id
options.description: Serial number of the remote metro array. It is required only in create and convert operations.

options.name: new_rdf_group_r1
options.description: The flag indicates whether or not to create a new RDFG for a Metro R1 array to a DR array, or to autoselect from an existing one. Used in only create operation.

options.name: new_rdf_group_r2
options.description: The flag indicates whether or not to create a new RDFG for a Metro R2 array to a DR array, or to autoselect from an existing one. It is used only in create operation.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: remove_r1_dr_rdfg
options.description: The flag indicates whether or not to override default behavior and delete R11-R2 RDFG from the metro R1 side. It is used only in delete operations.

options.name: replication_mode
options.description: Replication mode whose value will indicate how the data will be replicated. It is required in create and modify operations. It is a mandatory parameter in a create operation but optional in a modify operation.

options.name: sg_name
options.description: Name of the storage group. Storage group will be present on the primary metro array and a storage group with the same name will be created on remote and DR arrays in a create operation. Storage group name is required in 'create metro DR environment' and 'convert SG into metro DR environment' operations.

options.name: srdf_param
options.description: It contains parameters related to SRDF links. It is used only in modify operations.

options.name: state
options.description: State variable to determine whether metro DR environment will exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: The flag indicates if the operation should be run synchronously or asynchronously. True signifies synchronous execution. By default, create and convert are asynchronous operations, whereas modify is a synchronous operation.
